Container.Name: bens-tally
Container.Overview: Ben's Tally: a self-hosted personal finance tracker. Month-end net-worth snapshots, budget and spending from Up, Betashares investments imported from email, and a FIRE plan. Sign-in is through your own OIDC provider (Pocket-ID). All personal data lives in the appdata folder.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds tally.db and backups/. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: The address you open the app at. Sign-in and form checks depend on it.

Config.Name: OIDC client ID
Config.Description: From the Pocket-ID OIDC client (callback URL: https://tally.benpost.com/auth/callback).

Config.Name: Allowed subjects
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated Pocket-ID user IDs allowed in. Leave empty and the first person to sign in becomes the only allowed user.

Config.Name: Up token
Config.Description: Optional. An Up personal access token (api.up.com.au/getting_started). Read-only use: balances and transactions every 15 minutes.

Config.Name: Mail Worker URL
Config.Description: Optional. The Cloudflare mail Worker's address, e.g. https://tally-mail.example.workers.dev. Betashares order and income emails are collected from it every 15 minutes.

Config.Name: Mail Worker token
Config.Description: Optional. The APP_TOKEN secret set on the mail Worker.
